messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-apn1 (g5 family) showing sustained queue growth and failed scale-ups. Auto-created incident thread and paging.

pagerduty-bot: Paging erin (oncall) P1 at 22:10 UTC impacted: LedgerCo (enterprise) + several smaller customers

erin (oncall): Got the page. Pulling autoscaler logs and cloud responses. Status check: how many pending?

tasha (sre): Metrics snapshot: pending requests ~14,800; 1m queue growth +900; backend 95p latency 5.9s; error spike 429/503 . Autoscaler attempted N=12 creates -> 12 failures with mixed errors.

lucas (cloud): AWS API returned two distinct failure classes: ServiceQuotaExceeded for "GPU" and InsufficientInstanceCapacity for g5. Responses: 

`{"ErrorCode":"ServiceQuotaExceeded","Message":"Requested resource exceeds quota"}`

and

`{"ErrorCode":"InsufficientInstanceCapacity","Message":"We currently do not have sufficient capacity in the requested Availability Zone"}`

I'm opening case AWS-INC-2026-9009 for quota and flagged account-level urgent. Also checking spare capacity in other AZs/regions.

nina (prod-eng): Which pool/model is hottest? Any single-tenant batch?

tasha (sre): LedgerCo started a heavy reconciliation job at 21:58 UTC — long token sequences and streaming. They account for ~70% of the backlog. Non-LedgerCo traffic also rising but smaller.

rafael (support): LedgerCo reported increased timeouts for webhook callbacks and some payments stalled. They've DM'd an escalation request. Asking for ETA.

erin (oncall): Immediate mitigations we can run now: 1) emergency per-tenant concurrency cap for LedgerCo; 2) split routing for new requests to us-east-1 and eu-west-1; 3) swap to quantized 8-bit model for non-critical flows; 4) enable CPU fallback for tiny requests. Assigning owners.

nina (prod-eng): I'll flip the per-tenant limiter. Executing: `POST '/internal/ratelimit' -d '{"customer":"ledgerco","concurrency":6}'`

deploy-bot: Rate limit change applied by nina at 22:15 UTC.

tasha (sre): After limiter, pending down to ~9.6k. Good but still need extra GPUs. Lucas, can you test cross-region spill?

lucas (cloud): Spinning up canary pool in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Found spare g5 capacity in us-east-1 but spot/ondemand mix limited. Starting a 10% canary to us-east-1: `redwood route update --pool gpu-pool-apn1 --split 10:90 --to-regions us-east-1,ap-northeast-1`

deploy-bot: Route split job queued -> canary deployed.

nina (prod-eng): Canary looks healthy: latency ~1.0s on canary, 95th 1.2s, errors 0.1%. Rolling to 50% over 4 minutes.

lucas (cloud): AWS responded to case AWS-INC-2026-9009: provisional +40 GPUs for ap-northeast-1 granted immediately, formal review 3-5 hours. But note: AZ-level capacity for g5 is low; some creates will fail with InsufficientInstanceCapacity. I'm requesting placement in a different AZ and a fallback SKU (g4dn) if allowed.

erin (oncall): We should also enable model fallback to an 8-bit variant for non-enterprise routes to reduce GPU memory per host. Nina, can you coordinate?

nina (prod-eng): On it. Command: `redwood model deploy --pool gpu-pool-apn1 --model rprt-llama-13b-8bit --selector "!tier:enterprise" --graceful 30s`

deploy-bot: Model variant rollout started. 68% of non-enterprise traffic switched at 22:22 UTC.

tasha (sre): Memory usage per GPU dropped ~29%. Pending queue dropped to ~3.8k. Autoscaler still failing on a subset of creates due to capacity but provisional quota allowed some nodes.

lucas (cloud): Autoscaler log: attempt-to-create in az-a -> InsufficientInstanceCapacity, attempt-to-create in az-b -> success (provisional quota applied). Added 6 nodes at 22:26 UTC.

incident-bot: Autoscaler resumed; added 6 nodes to gpu-pool-apn1 at 22:26 UTC.

erin (oncall): Rafael, please update LedgerCo: temporary concurrency cap, routing to other regions, model fallbacks in effect; ETA for full capacity ~3h (pending AWS formal quota & AZ capacity). Offer priority handling for their critical flows.

rafael (support): Sent update at 22:30 UTC. LedgerCo asked to prioritize three merchant flows; shared request IDs. I created a ticket with the list.

nina (prod-eng): Also enabling CPU fallback for tiny requests (<=64 tokens) to free GPU cycles: `redwood config set --pool gpu-pool-apn1 --cpu-fallback-threshold 64`

deploy-bot: CPU fallback enabled at 22:31 UTC. Small requests now served on CPU workers.

tasha (sre): Post-mitigation metrics: inflight ~1.7k, pending ~900, 95th latency 1.4s for routed traffic, error rate near baseline. LedgerCo still has a few long jobs queued but priority flows prioritized.

lucas (cloud): AWS case updated: requested permanent +200 GPUs for account in ap-northeast-1 and asked for proactive AZ rebalancing. Case ID AWS-INC-2026-9009. AWS rep gave tentative ETA 4-6 hours for full review. Logging partner fallbacks as plan C (baremetal partner in apac).

erin (oncall): Short timeline for RCA/handoff notes: * 22:10 UTC alert fired for gpu-pool-apn1. * 22:15 UTC applied per-tenant rate limit for LedgerCo. * 22:18 UTC route canary to us-east-1; rolled to 50% by 22:23. * 22:22 UTC model fallback to 8-bit for non-enterprise. * 22:26 UTC provisional +40 GPUs applied, autoscaler added 6 nodes. * 22:31 UTC CPU fallback enabled for <=64 token requests. * Impact summary: LedgerCo saw increased latency and webhook delays primarily between 21:58-22:26 UTC; mitigations restored service. Follow-ups: autoscaler AZ-placement fix, preflight quota checks, partner fallback runbook, permanent quota case AWS-INC-2026-9009.

erin (oncall): Handoff: I'll stay on-call until 23:00 UTC to validate stability. Tasha will take post-incident ownership and drive RCA.

tasha (sre): Acknowledged. I'll start the incident postmortem and include a runbook update to check AZ-level capacity before scaling and an automated per-tenant backpressure rule.

rafael (support): I'll compile customer-impact logs and publish to ops-docs/incident-1955550000/ledgerco_impacted.txt.

depLOY-bot: Incident AWS-INC-2026-9009 linked to ops-docs incident folder.

pagerduty-bot: Primary page acknowledged at 22:35 UTC; P1 paging closed for immediate ops.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by erin (oncall). This thread remains for RCA and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
